item.title: In Good Company
item.description:
Thursday, August 13, 2026 at 12 PM

Location: 5601A Navigation Blvd, Houston, TX 77011

A free event previewing the newest episode of online artist conversation series In Good Company featuring Houston artists Tay Butler and Jeremy Samuel Johnson. See excerpts from the forthcoming episode, followed by an in-person conversation between the artists.

From Aurora Picture Show

item.title: Filmmaking Camps 2026 Premiere
item.description:
Saturday, August 15, 2026 at 12 PM

Location: 5601A Navigation Blvd, Houston, TX 77011

Aurora Picture Show and the Museum of Fine Arts, Houston present the free premiere screening of short films made collaboratively by artists ages 7-15 in Aurora’s 2026 Summer Youth Filmmaking Camps at the museum’s Brown Auditorium.
